title: Clean up the small copy slips: invented claims, 1 seats left, hidden em dashes, a dead theme card
detail: Deep audit 2026-11-19, copy findings re-checked on main 2026-11-20. Fixed: (1) invented claims, "Yes. Most people do." on five theme FAQs and circle meetups, and "pick one before it fills" urgency in four kit emails; (2) counts that did not pluralise: "Search 1 members", "1 seats left" / "0 seats left" (now "This circle is full"), "1 seats open", enrolment "1 seats left", channel "1 members", "made 1 of the last 1 gatherings"; (3) em dashes and jargon in the QR destination copy shown in the Space loyalty console, and check-canon COPY_KEYS now reads value, detail and lede (two admin-only files classified operator, "gems" capitalised); (4) the Nocturne demo metadata said Midnight; (5) a dead "Woman, Coming soon" theme card removed from Space branding; (6) Vera tool text named the janitor role; (7) long emails on sign-in and in the host guest list now wrap at 390px. Left as is: "About 12 minutes" on /create-a-space rests on the measured LIVE-1970 median; "1 Journeys open" in the Midnight block is pinned by midnight.test.tsx and needs the owner's phrase to change.

verify.note: Fails on main: the claims, unpluralised counts, dashes, Midnight name and Woman card are all present. Passes once each is fixed.
